_doc: Paid upgrades the system will never take on its own (owner, 2026-11-16: keep every tenant on free tiers; QNFO's cost ran away with no return). Each is a decision for the owner with its monthly cost and the default in effect (stay free). Read by dashboard/worker.js (OWNER-DASH-2). Prices are Cloudflare and GitHub list prices as of the date in `checked`; the dashboard shows that date.

options.title: Cloudflare Workers Paid plan (ultrastable account)
options.cost: 5 USD per month, plus usage past the included amounts
options.unlocks: Removes the D1 daily read and write caps and the 100,000 requests a day cap. The free D1 read cap was hit on 2026-11-16 (dashboard and data copies fail until 00:00 UTC).
options.default: Stay free. Work that needs more reads waits for the daily reset or is cut down (hourly dashboard probes, tenant copies split across days).

options.title: Workers AI beyond the free daily allowance
options.cost: Usage-billed past 10,000 neurons a day (about 0.011 USD per 1,000 neurons) on the Workers Paid plan
options.unlocks: More console-agent and tenant model calls per day.
options.default: Stay free. Calls past the allowance fail; the cheapest model is used first.

options.title: GitHub Actions minutes for ultrastable
options.cost: 0 USD while within the included private-repo minutes; anything past that is billed to the spending limit you set
options.unlocks: Hosted checks, lane merges and deploys. When a payment fails or the spending limit is zero, GitHub refuses hosted jobs.
options.default: Worker loops and the cloud routine carry the work whenever hosted jobs are refused (ZERO-MINUTES-1).

options.title: Renew the four ultrastable domains
options.cost: Registrar price per domain per year, charged at renewal on 2027-11-10 (auto-renew is off)
options.default: Domains lapse on 2027-11-10 unless renewed. Nothing is charged before then.

known_plan.source: owner: Workers Paid turned on for the ultrastable account
